test_cases.test_name: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that documents can be assigned to users/groups and that electronic acknowledgment signatures are properly captured and tracked
prerequisites: System installed and configured
Test users created with appropriate roles
Test documents available in system

test_steps.action: Log into the system as an administrator and navigate to the document assignment module
test_steps.expected_result: Administrator successfully logs in and can access the document assignment interface

test_steps.action: Assign a test document to a specific user using the vendor UI as specified in URS-021-001
test_steps.expected_result: Document is successfully assigned to the user with confirmation message displayed

test_steps.action: Log in as the assigned user and navigate to the document acknowledgment section
test_steps.expected_result: User can see the assigned document requiring acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Complete the electronic acknowledgment process using vendor-provided signature mechanism per URS-021-005
test_steps.expected_result: Electronic signature is captured and acknowledgment is recorded with timestamp

test_steps.action: Verify the audit trail shows the assignment and acknowledgment events per URS-021-007
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail contains complete records of both assignment and acknowledgment events

acceptance_criteria: Documents can be successfully assigned to users
Electronic acknowledgment signatures are properly captured
Audit trail records all assignment and acknowledgment events
All regulatory requirements for electronic signatures are met
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signatures requirements
EU Annex 11 electronic records requirements
Data integrity ALCOA+ principles
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all assignment and acknowledgment events
Electronic signatures must be securely linked to specific users
Timestamp accuracy must be maintained for all events

test_cases.test_name: Automated Reminder and Reporting Functionality Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that automated reminders are sent according to schedule and that standard acknowledgment reports can be generated within performance requirements
prerequisites: System configured with email/SMS settings
Test users with pending acknowledgments
Scheduler configured for reminder intervals

test_steps.action: Configure the vendor scheduler to send reminders for overdue acknowledgments per URS-021-002
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduler configuration is successfully saved with specified reminder intervals

test_steps.action: Assign documents to test users and allow acknowledgment due dates to pass
test_steps.expected_result: Documents are assigned and due dates are properly tracked by the system

test_steps.action: Monitor the scheduler execution and verify automated reminders are sent to users with overdue acknowledgments
test_steps.expected_result: Automated reminders are sent according to the configured schedule to appropriate users

test_steps.action: Generate a standard acknowledgment report for 50,000 records as specified in URS-021-003 and URS-021-009
test_steps.expected_result: Report is generated successfully within 10 seconds and contains accurate acknowledgment data

test_steps.action: Verify role-based dashboards display appropriate acknowledgment metrics for managers per URS-021-004
test_steps.expected_result: Managers can access dashboards showing relevant acknowledgment completion metrics for their teams

acceptance_criteria: Automated reminders are sent according to configured schedule
Reports generate within 10 seconds for 50k records
Role-based dashboards display accurate acknowledgment metrics
All performance requirements are met
regulatory_basis: Data integrity requirements for timely completion tracking
Management oversight requirements for compliance monitoring
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must accurately reflect current acknowledgment status
Reminder records must be maintained in audit trail
Dashboard metrics must be real-time and accurate

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system maintains a complete and immutable audit trail for all document assignment and acknowledgment activities as required by regulatory standards.
prerequisites: System administrator access
Test users configured in the system
Test documents uploaded to the system
Audit trail reporting feature enabled

test_steps.action: Assign a test document to a test user using the vendor UI and record the assignment timestamp
test_steps.expected_result: Document is successfully assigned to the test user with confirmation message

test_steps.action: Log in as the test user and acknowledge the assigned document using the electronic signature feature
test_steps.expected_result: Document is successfully acknowledged with electronic signature recorded

test_steps.action: Access the audit trail report feature and generate a report for the test period covering both assignment and acknowledgment events
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail report is generated successfully showing both assignment and acknowledgment events with complete metadata

test_steps.action: Verify the audit trail entries contain all required information including user identification, timestamp, action type, and before/after values if applicable
test_steps.expected_result: All audit trail entries contain complete information with no missing data fields and proper sequencing of events

acceptance_criteria: Audit trail captures all assignment and acknowledgment events with complete metadata
Audit trail records are immutable and cannot be modified by users
All timestamp data is accurate and consistent across events
Audit trail report includes all required regulatory information
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
Annex 11 - Computerized Systems
FDA Data Integrity Requirements
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ principles must be maintained for all audit trail entries
Audit trail must be automatically generated without user intervention
Records must be protected from modification or deletion
Timestamp accuracy must be maintained across all system events
urs_requirements: URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Verification

test_cases.test_name: Active Directory Group Synchronization and User Management Integration
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly synchronizes user groups from Active Directory using the standard connector and properly maps them for document assignment purposes.
prerequisites: Active Directory test environment
Test user groups configured in AD
Standard AD connector installed and configured
System administrator access to both AD and document system

test_steps.action: Create a test user group in Active Directory with 5 test users as members
test_steps.expected_result: Test group is successfully created in AD with all specified users as members

test_steps.action: Initiate manual synchronization process using the standard AD connector in the document system
test_steps.expected_result: Synchronization process completes successfully without errors

test_steps.action: Verify in the document system that the AD test group and its members are correctly imported and available for assignment
test_steps.expected_result: AD test group and all member users are correctly displayed in the document system user management interface

test_steps.action: Assign a test document to the synchronized AD group using the vendor UI and verify all group members receive the assignment
test_steps.expected_result: Document is successfully assigned to the AD group and all group members show the assignment in their acknowledgment queue

test_steps.action: Modify the AD test group membership by adding/removing users and initiate another synchronization to verify update propagation
test_steps.expected_result: Group membership changes are correctly synchronized and reflected in the document system user assignments

acceptance_criteria: AD groups synchronize completely and accurately using standard connector
User membership changes propagate correctly to document assignments
Synchronization process handles errors gracefully without data loss
Group-based document assignments function correctly with synchronized groups
regulatory_basis: Annex 11 - Computerized Systems
GAMP 5 - Supplier and Service Provider Management
Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP
data_integrity_requirements: User group data must maintain integrity during synchronization process
Membership changes must be accurately reflected in the system
Synchronization failures must be logged and reported
Data mapping between systems must be consistent and accurate
urs_requirements: URS-021-010: Sync user groups from AD via standard connector
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Verification

test_cases.test_name: High Volume Document Assignment and Performance Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can handle 10,000 document assignments per day and generate reports for 50k records in under 10 seconds as specified in performance requirements.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test environment with sufficient data load capability
Access to performance monitoring tools
Test dataset of 50,000+ acknowledgment records

test_steps.action: Configure system to simulate 10,000 document assignments using automated test scripts
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts all assignments without errors or performance degradation

test_steps.action: Execute batch assignment process and monitor system performance metrics
test_steps.expected_result: All 10,000 assignments are processed within 24-hour period

test_steps.action: Generate standard acknowledgment report for 50,000 records and measure execution time
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes in less than 10 seconds

acceptance_criteria: System successfully processes 10,000 document assignments within 24 hours
Report generation for 50,000 records completes in under 10 seconds
No system crashes or critical errors during high-volume processing
System resources remain within acceptable limits during peak load
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic records requirements
Annex 11 - Computerized systems validation
FDA guidance on computerized systems in clinical investigations
data_integrity_requirements: All assignment records must be complete and accurate
Report data must match source records exactly
No data loss or corruption during high-volume operations
urs_requirements: URS-021-009: Report generation < 10 seconds for 50k records
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Verification
OQ-002: Automated Reminder and Reporting Functionality Verification

test_cases.test_name: Electronic Signature and Record Retention Compliance Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that electronic signatures are properly captured and acknowledgment records are maintained according to retention policies and regulatory requirements.
prerequisites: System with configured retention policies
Test users with appropriate access rights
Document assignments created for testing
Access to audit trail functionality

test_steps.action: Assign a document to a test user and have them complete electronic acknowledgment
test_steps.expected_result: Electronic signature is captured with timestamp and user identity

test_steps.action: Verify the acknowledgment record contains all required elements per regulatory requirements
test_steps.expected_result: Record includes user ID, timestamp, document version, and signature meaning

test_steps.action: Test record retention by attempting to delete/modify acknowledgment records beyond user permissions
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents unauthorized modification or deletion of records

test_steps.action: Verify audit trail captures all assignment and acknowledgment activities
test_steps.expected_result: Complete audit trail exists for all test activities with proper timestamp and user identification

acceptance_criteria: Electronic signatures are captured with all required 21 CFR Part 11 elements
Acknowledgment records are maintained according to defined retention policies
Audit trail captures all critical activities with proper attribution
Records cannot be modified or deleted without proper authorization
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic signatures and records
EU Annex 11 - Electronic data integrity requirements
FDA Data Integrity and Compliance With CGMP guidance
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be unique to individual users
Records must be protected from alteration or deletion
Audit trails must be secure, time-stamped, and attributable
Data must be retained for required period per retention policy
urs_requirements: URS-021-005: Support vendor-provided electronic acknowledgment signature
URS-021-006: Maintain acknowledgment records per retention policy
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Verification
OQ-003: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Dashboard Access and Functionality Verification
test_cases.objective: To verify that role-based dashboards correctly display relevant acknowledgment metrics and reports based on user permissions and roles.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users with different roles (e.g., Manager, User, Admin) are created
Documents have been assigned to users
Acknowledgment records exist in the system

test_steps.action: Log in to the system as a user with Manager role permissions.
test_steps.expected_result: Login is successful and the Manager dashboard is displayed with appropriate metrics.
data_to_capture: List of available metrics and reports

test_steps.action: Navigate through all dashboard components and verify access to acknowledgment reports.
test_steps.expected_result: All dashboard components are accessible and display correct acknowledgment data for the manager's scope.

test_steps.action: Log out and log in as a standard user without managerial privileges.
test_steps.expected_result: Login is successful and a limited or different dashboard view is presented.

test_steps.action: Attempt to access managerial dashboard features and reports.
test_steps.expected_result: Access to managerial features is restricted according to role-based permissions.

acceptance_criteria: Role-based dashboards display appropriate metrics for each user role
Managerial users can access comprehensive acknowledgment reports
Standard users cannot access managerial dashboard features
All dashboard data accurately reflects current acknowledgment status
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic records requirements
Annex 11 - Computerized Systems
Data integrity ALCOA+ principles
data_integrity_requirements: Dashboard must display accurate and current acknowledgment data
Role-based access must prevent unauthorized data viewing
All displayed metrics must be traceable to source records
urs_requirements: URS-021-004: Provide role-based dashboards for managers
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Workflow Verification
OQ-002: Automated Reminder and Reporting Functionality Verification

test_cases.test_name: Electronic Signature Compliance and Record Retention Verification
test_cases.objective: To verify that electronic signatures for document acknowledgments comply with regulatory requirements and that records are properly retained according to policy.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users are created
Documents have been assigned for acknowledgment
Retention policy settings are configured

test_steps.action: Have a test user acknowledge a document using the electronic signature feature.
test_steps.expected_result: Document is successfully acknowledged with electronic signature capture.

test_steps.action: Verify the electronic signature record contains all required elements: printed name, date/time, meaning of signature.
test_steps.expected_result: Electronic signature record includes all required regulatory elements in a secure, attributable format.

test_steps.action: Check the audit trail for the acknowledgment event to verify proper recording.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail contains complete record of the acknowledgment event with before/after values if applicable.

test_steps.action: Verify the acknowledgment record is stored according to the configured retention policy.
test_steps.expected_result: Record is properly stored and can be retrieved within the retention period.

test_steps.action: Test record retrieval after simulated time passage to verify retention enforcement.
test_steps.expected_result: Records are accessible during retention period and properly handled after expiration.

acceptance_criteria: Electronic signatures contain all required regulatory elements
Audit trail properly records all acknowledgment events
Records are retained according to configured retention policy
Expired records are handled appropriately per policy
All signature records are secure and tamper-evident
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic signatures requirements
EU Annex 11 - Electronic records and signatures
FDA Data Integrity Guidance
Record retention requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, and accurate
Records must be retained for required duration per policy
Audit trails must be secure and complete
Data must be protected from alteration or deletion
urs_requirements: URS-021-005: Support vendor-provided electronic acknowledgment signature
URS-021-006: Maintain acknowledgment records per retention policy
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-003: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments
OQ-006: Electronic Signature and Record Retention Compliance Verification

test_cases.test_name: System Scalability and Performance Under Peak Load Conditions
test_cases.objective: Verify the system maintains acceptable performance when handling the maximum specified daily volume of 10,000 document assignments and generating reports under load.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test environment with performance monitoring tools is available
Test dataset of at least 50,000 acknowledgment records exists
Access to load generation tool or script

test_steps.action: Configure performance monitoring to track system response times and resource utilization.
test_steps.expected_result: Monitoring tools are active and capturing baseline system metrics.

test_steps.action: Execute a script to simulate 10,000 document assignments to various user groups over a 24-hour period.
test_steps.expected_result: All 10,000 assignments are processed successfully without system errors or performance degradation.
data_to_capture: System resource utilization during peak load

test_steps.action: Generate a standard acknowledgment report against the dataset of 50,000 records.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes in less than 10 seconds as specified in URS-021-009.

acceptance_criteria: System processes 10,000 assignments within 24 hours without failure
Report generation completes in under 10 seconds for 50,000 records
System remains stable and responsive throughout the test
No data corruption or loss occurs during high-volume operations
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - System performance and reliability requirements
Annex 11 - computerized systems should not be affected by the volume of data
data_integrity_requirements: All assignment records must be accurately processed and stored
Report data must be complete and accurate regardless of volume
Audit trail entries must be maintained for all high-volume operations

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail Integrity and Regulatory Compliance Verification
test_cases.objective: Validate that the system maintains a complete and secure audit trail for all document assignment and acknowledgment activities as required by regulatory standards.
prerequisites: System is operational with audit trail functionality enabled
Test users with various roles are configured
Sample documents are available for assignment
Access to audit trail review functionality

test_steps.action: Assign a document to a test user and have the user acknowledge it using the electronic signature feature.
test_steps.expected_result: Assignment and acknowledgment activities are recorded in the audit trail with appropriate timestamps and user identification.

test_steps.action: Modify an existing document assignment and observe audit trail capture.
test_steps.expected_result: All modifications to assignments are captured in the audit trail, including before/after values where applicable.

test_steps.action: Generate and review the audit trail report for the test activities performed.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail report provides a complete, chronological record of all test activities that cannot be altered or deleted.

acceptance_criteria: All assignment and acknowledgment activities generate appropriate audit trail entries
Audit trail captures user identity, timestamp, and action details for each event
Audit trail records are secure, timestamped, and cannot be modified
Audit trail reporting provides complete and accurate historical records
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Audit trail requirements for electronic records
EU Annex 11 - Principles of data integrity and audit trails
ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be generated automatically for all relevant activities
Audit trail records must be immutable and time-stamped
Audit trail must capture the identity of the person making the entry
Audit trail must be retained according to retention policy requirements
